title: Operation Blue Skies is Google’s mission to help pilots avoid contrails.
summary: The company calls it the world’s first state-backed trial aimed at mitigating warming contrails across an entire flight corridor — specifically the eastern half of the North Atlantic corridor, which accounts for around 5 percent of global contrail warming.
